reviews.text: love the workers ! especially the only guy there at the moment ! amazing customer service 10/10 i come here every week ! for my dog and cat . amazing products and great atmosphere

***STAY AWAY FROM THIS DISGUSTING EXCUSE OF A BUSINESS***  avoid this place at all costs, the owner is an extremely arrogant guy, also if you do go here make sure you check amazon first because 90% of their items are on amazon for half the price! I was looking at collars for my dog and cat and they have them for $14.99 and the same exact brands are on Amazon for $4.99! Charging more to make profit is one thing but charging triple the price of something is taking advantage of peoples money. Also, alot of their dog foods are expired and when i mentioned it to the owner i seen one that said “Exp 12/2024” he told me that is the manufacture date, I was in shock. PLEASE Take your money somewhere where it is actually appreciated! The staff are nice, but the owner needs a major reality check. This business will be forwarded to the Better Business Bureau for further investigations.

The young lady who assisted me was so helpful when I needed to find something for my picky dog she suggested a meal topper, all I do now crush it on his food and he's been gobbling it up!! I LOVE their choices of natural foods for my baby and probably spent way to much but I couldnt help myself 😂 I definitely want to give the grooming a try but haven't gotten a chance to book an appointment yet

I absolutely love Crosby Pet Center, the staff is friendly, knowledgeable and genuinely cares about the animals. The store is clean, well stocked, and organized,  I always find healthy, happy pets here. They always take time to answer my questions, and I never feel rushed. Great experience every time!
Great and friendly service, would bring my dog back!

Best pet shop in the BX, awesome staff... very friendly and knowledgeable!!! I get my dog Penny groomed there once a month and she's always so happy to go, they do a terrific job and are priced very fairly compared to other shops I've visited... Crosby Pet has me as a customer for life!!!!!

This place is a joke, 25 wax worms for $8 every other pet store sells them for $5 which brings 50, avoid buying at this joke of a store, they are more worried about their exotic cat in the store than their own prices!!
Always great!!!!!
Very welcoming
This is my to go to place for all my pet needs. Dean is great always answer all my question. Everyone that works here is attentive and friendly.
They did a beautiful job on my Yorkie, made her look like a show dog! Will definitely return! Love the groomers here!

I’ve been coming to this neighborhood pet shop for years, and it truly feels like part of the community. The staff is always welcoming, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about both the pets and their owners. You can tell they take pride in what they do. They’re  always ready to offer helpful advice without ever making you feel rushed or pressured.

What I love most is the personal touch. They remember their customers, ask about your pets, and go the extra mile to make sure you find exactly what you need. The store is always clean, well-stocked, and full of quality products you can trust.
Groomers did a fantastic job on both my dogs.... i tried many groomers in the area... Crosby was the best priced and did my dogs the best out of any other place I been to... wll return again

I will never let them touch my dogs again

Small shop but great inventory and pet care advice.  Highly recommended.
they have cool birds but the cages are NOT it. they have too many birds in one tiny cage.
Dean is the BEST!
Sophia is the best, my dog is always nervous but she knows how to calm her.  Always satisfied with Shopia's knowledge and attention.

Took my mother's dog in for grooming.Pleased with the grooming. Thank you Lisa
for doing an amazing job! Highly recommend their grooming services!
Amazing service from start to finish. Impressed with how smoothly it went.
We've been getting our dogs groomed there for 9 years, Enza always does an excellent job

My husband and I always pass by this pet shop it’s spotless and everything is easy to find. We went in for a new fish tank and food, but couldn’t resist bringing home a new fish for our tank. We’ll definitely be back in a few months for a bigger tank!
Kind, compassionate and affordable.

They manage to cram a lot of stuff into a such a small space it is amazing honestly. I've gotten a ton of supplies for my foster kittens, entire aquarium setups and the fish to put in them. It's crazy that this is the only small business that sells freshwater fish that I know of in the bronx. I'd have to go to a chain or to Long island, and they wouldn't have a selection like this.  They definitely keep a few oddball fish that I love.
Friendly staff. Got my little Daisy from here💜 …

I absolutely love Crosby Pet Center! The staff is incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about the well-being of every pet that walks through their doors. Every time I visit, the store is clean, well-stocked, and welcoming. They offer a great selection of pet supplies, from high-quality food to fun toys and accessories. What really sets them apart is the personal attention and helpful advice—they always go the extra mile to make sure you and your pets are happy. Whether you're a first-time pet owner or a long-time animal lover, Crosby Pet Center is the place to go. Highly recommended.
Very knowledgeable people working there and very helpful

Bought my mini poodle here! And I’ve gotten him groomed here twice with Jane. I love the staff and how clean the store is. Dean and Pete are my regular helpers and always answer all my questions. 10/10 store.
Deans a cool dude! Friendly service

got our puppy from this place, and it was such a good decision! they were helpful and helped us out a lot with tips and supplies. we visit often with our puppy and he loves it. always coming back for our puppy’s food and supplies.
Awesome pet shop. Dean is so extremely helpful and very attentive. Thank you!
The best pet store in the BX

I cannot recommend this shop enough! I walked in feeling overwhelmed, searching for a temporary food option for my American Bully, who suffers from severe allergies, while waiting for a dermatologist appointment. The staff were incredibly kind, patient, and knowledgeable.

They took the time to listen to my concerns, asked  questions about my dog, and suggested a few allergy-friendly options. They even explained the ingredients and why each product might be a good fit. Their genuine care and expertise made a stressful situation so much easier.

If you’re looking for a shop that truly cares about you and your pets, this is the place to go!
Very friendly and helpful with any questions and concerns.
Great store. Helpful employees (shout out Dean) and good prices. Cant complain about spending money on a pure bred if that’s what you’re looking for! Have had 2 dogs from Crosby and both amazing.
BEST PET SHOP!! Dean is the mannnn

This shop has been so welcoming. I come to get food for my dog and get amazing advice on how to care for my dog’s ears and saved hundreds in vet bills. I will continue to be a regular customer. I look forward to bringing my dog for his first grooming next week.
Always get the best advice for my animal when I come here. Welcoming and ready to help and assist w any problems my pups have been going here for years❤️
Dean, Linda and the whole staff are always so helpful especially with my dog Toby, he loves going there!
This shop has everything you need and more. It’s nearby and super convenient for me. I will be shopping here more often!

Great shop!!!!!! They did a great job grooming, our Benny boy he’s always excited to go to the pet shop. The employees there are awesome they treat everyone so well. And you can tell that they love animals, the store is always clean and you can find almost anything you need there. I highly recommend this place. Keep up the good work guys.
